rationale: The assistant correctly recognised the query was out of scope (a car) and politely declined, listing the household appliances it covers and pointing the customer to 'A garage or the manufacturer's support line'. It made no fabricated claims and did not run an appliance-style diagnostic. It fell slightly short of the ideal by not mentioning breakdown cover or that a battery light usually indicates a charging-system fault, and by omitting the modest safety note to avoid long journeys until checked.
